name: Fill the Cup
desc:
🥤 Welcome to Fill the Cup!
🌍 The entire Roblox world shares ONE massive cup… help fill it up!
🕹️ Play fun minigames to boost 😇 or drain 😈 the fill level.

❓ Think you can fill it? And what will happen when it's finally full?

⭐ Like & favorite for rewards and future updates!
